ai_guide_appeal.title: What if you had a travel buddy in your pocket that never stops talking…
ai_guide_appeal.desc: What if an AI guide narrated the story of the street, a little-known detail, or said "there's an amazing simit stand 5 minutes ahead" out loud as you walked — how would that feel to you?

personalization_appeal.title: What if the app knew you, instead of recommending the same thing to everyone…
personalization_appeal.desc: What if you had a "Travel DNA" that learned your tastes and past trips to suggest places and routes made just for you?

gamification_appeal.title: What if traveling turned into a game…
gamification_appeal.desc: What if you completed small quests at the places you visit, earned points and badges, and compared scores with friends?

avatar_quest_appeal.title: What if those badges became a character…
avatar_quest_appeal.desc: What if you used the points and badges you earned to level up your own 3D avatar and send it on new quests?

local_deals_appeal.title: What if a surprise appeared right there, right then…
local_deals_appeal.desc: What if you saw instant special discounts and deals from cafés, restaurants, or events near you?

explorer.title: Explorer
explorer.tagline: You're not afraid to go off the map
explorer.description: New streets and unknown corners are an invitation to you. Frawell's 24/7 AI guide will whisper stories you've never heard at every step you take.

social.title: Social Butterfly
social.tagline: The best memories are shared memories
social.description: Traveling is a "we" story for you. Frawell's group planning mode keeps everyone on the same page, so you can just focus on the fun.

foodie.title: Flavor Hunter
foodie.description: You get to know a city by tasting it. As your Travel DNA develops, Frawell will recommend that hidden café or restaurant down the street, picked just for you.

gamer.title: Gamer Traveler
gamer.tagline: Every trip is a level for you
gamer.description: Badges, points, quests — music to your ears. Every step you take in Frawell levels up your 3D avatar, and the quests you complete bring real rewards.

planner.title: Master Planner
planner.tagline: Everything should be in one place
planner.description: Opening dozens of tabs isn't your style. Frawell brings everything together in one screen — from transport to routes, budget to check-in.

calm.title: Calm Spirit
calm.tagline: At your own pace, in your own peace
calm.description: You love exploring without rushing, away from the crowds. Frawell will show you the calmest corners with real-time crowd info.
